title: Desenvolvendo meu primeiro aplicativo com Flutter
codeBlocks:
git clone https://github.com/kleberandrade/calculadora-imc-aulas-flutter.git
cd calculadora-imc-aulas-flutter
flutter --version
flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile
flutter run -d chrome

name: calculadora_imc
description: An educational adult BMI calculator with validated metric inputs.
publish_to: none
version: 2.0.0+2
environment:
  sdk: '>=3.14.0 <4.0.0'
  flutter: '>=3.50.0'
dependencies:
  flutter:
    sdk: flutter
  material_ui: ^1.11.1
dev_dependencies:
  flutter_test:
    sdk: flutter
  flutter_lints: ^6.0.0
flutter:
  uses-material-design: true

flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile
dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed lib test
flutter analyze
flutter test --coverage
flutter build web --release
